notes:
One fix for two tablets, and a troubleshooting recorder.

**Hiding or reordering pages now redraws the other tablet.** With two tablets, hiding the last page of a piece could leave the second tablet showing the page it had before, instead of redrawing. It now wakes and redraws, the same way it does for a page turn.

**Record what the tablet is doing.** A new switch in the reader settings, off unless you turn it on, which keeps a rolling record of what the app and the screen are doing. It is only for chasing a fault that happens away from a computer, such as a page turn that does not reach the other tablet. It keeps a few days at most and drops the oldest as it goes. Leave it off unless asked.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
